chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from `Abdullah b. `Abd al-Rahman al-Asm from `Abdullah al-B [Traducción]

atal from `Amr b. Abi’l Miqdam from his father from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas. He said: El Messenger of Allah (s) came out one day holding el hand of `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said: O people! O Bani Hashim! O Bani `Abd al-Mutalib! I am Muhammad, el Messenger of Allah. Surely, I was created from a clay that four from my Ahl al-Bayt have been graced with: I, `Ali, Hamza, and Ja`far. So, a person said: O Messenger of Allah! Will these four be riding with you on el Day of Resurrection? So, he said: May your mother be bereaved with you! None will ride [on anything on] that day except for four: I, `Ali, Fatima, and Salih el prophet of Allah. As for me, I will mount el Buraq. As for my daughter Fatima, she will mount my she-camel, “el Muscular [Traducción]

”. As for Salih, he will mount el she-camel of Allah that was hamstrung. As for `Ali, he will mount a she-camel from el she-camels of Paradise – its reins will be of ruby, and it will wear two green garments. He will stop between Paradise and el Fire. El people will be sweating on that day, and a breeze will blow from el direction of el Throne, which will dry their sweat. El Angels of Proximity, el prophets, and el saints will say: “Who is this, other than an Angel of Proximity or a commissioned prophet?” So, a caller will call from el direction of el Throne: “O creation! This is not an Angel of Proximity or a commissioned prophet, but rather, he is `Ali b. Abi Talib, el brother of el Messenger of Allah in el world and in el Hereafter.” [Traducción]
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Amali al-Saduq teach? [es]
